title: unfamiliar
description: A horror mod adding creatures, structures, and biomes to your world. Do not believe everything you see.
body:
Building will not protect you.
Hiding will not save you.
Nowhere is safe.
**They know where you are.**

A horror mod adding events, creatures, and structures to explore and ~~survive~~.
Many things will spawn around you, and you have to find a way to survive.
**This WILL kick you from your game**
**This WILL have loud noises**
**This CAN destroy your world**
